title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29): Use conditional visibility in the updated Word add-in (Hide If Empty/False in Word Layout)
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 2 introduces conditional visibility controls in the Word add-in, allowing developers to design reports with hidden or shown content based on boolean fields using HideIf logic - a capability previously only available in RDLC layouts.
key_points: BC29's updated Word add-in adds a HideIf logic control so Word layouts can show or hide content conditionally, something earlier achieved in RDLC with decision functions like IIF.
Under the Visibility tab, the Hide If Empty actions are Hide Field if Zero, Hide Empty Table, Hide Empty Table Row and Hide Empty Table Column, each needing a specific selection.
Hide If False opens a dialog whose options depend on the current selection and lets you pick a boolean field from the report dataset, including ones added by report extensions.
Install the latest add-in version (3.0.0.0) from the Word Add-ins menu to get these controls.

quotes.text: Awesome! That gives us one more reason to skip RDLC.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the significance: developers now have less reason to use the more complex RDLC layout type for conditional visibility scenarios.
